<document id="products-checks">
Checkbooks,ˆcashier'sˆchecksˆandˆmoneyˆordersˆTallowbrookˆdoesn'tˆofferˆpaperˆcheckbooks,ˆcashier'sˆchecksˆorˆmoneyˆorders.ˆ##ˆPayingˆsomeoneˆwhoˆneedsˆaˆcheckˆOptionsˆincludeˆBrookPayˆ(ifˆthey'reˆaˆTallowbrookˆmember),ˆanˆACHˆtransferˆtoˆtheirˆbankˆaccount,ˆorˆaˆwire.ˆManyˆlandlordsˆacceptˆACH.ˆ##ˆDepositingˆchecksˆYouˆcanˆdepositˆpaperˆchecksˆmadeˆoutˆtoˆyouˆbyˆtakingˆaˆphotoˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSeeˆ"Depositingˆaˆcheckˆinˆtheˆapp".ˆ##ˆMoneyˆordersˆWeˆcan'tˆissueˆmoneyˆorders,ˆandˆmoneyˆordersˆcan'tˆbeˆdepositedˆthroughˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆClosingˆbalanceˆchecksˆTheˆonlyˆtimeˆweˆmailˆaˆcheckˆisˆwhenˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccountˆwithoutˆaˆlinkedˆexternalˆaccount.ˆWeˆsendˆtheˆremainingˆbalanceˆbyˆcheck.ˆ##ˆDirectˆdepositˆformsˆthatˆaskˆforˆaˆvoidedˆcheckˆUseˆtheˆpre-filledˆdirectˆdepositˆformˆinˆtheˆappˆinstead.ˆItˆhasˆeverythingˆaˆvoidedˆcheckˆwouldˆshow.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="check-deposit-how">
DepositingˆaˆcheckˆinˆtheˆappˆYouˆcanˆdepositˆpaperˆchecksˆbyˆtakingˆaˆphotoˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆdepositˆ1.ˆSignˆtheˆbackˆofˆtheˆcheck.ˆ2.ˆUnderˆyourˆsignature,ˆwriteˆ"ForˆmobileˆdepositˆonlyˆatˆTallowbrook".ˆ3.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆDepositˆaˆcheck.ˆ4.ˆEnterˆtheˆamountˆandˆphotographˆtheˆfrontˆandˆbackˆonˆaˆdarkˆsurface.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆmobileˆcheckˆdepositˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ##ˆKeepˆtheˆcheckˆKeepˆtheˆpaperˆcheckˆforˆ14ˆdaysˆafterˆit'sˆdeposited,ˆthenˆdestroyˆit.ˆDon'tˆdepositˆtheˆsameˆcheckˆanywhereˆelse.ˆ##ˆChecksˆweˆcan'tˆacceptˆChecksˆmadeˆoutˆtoˆsomeoneˆelse,ˆchecksˆfromˆoutsideˆtheˆUS,ˆmoneyˆorders,ˆandˆchecksˆwithoutˆtheˆendorsementˆabove.ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheˆmoneyˆisˆavailableˆSeeˆ"Whenˆcheckˆdepositsˆareˆavailable".ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆtheˆreleaseˆdateˆafterˆyouˆsubmitˆtheˆdeposit.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="check-deposit-availability">
WhenˆcheckˆdepositsˆareˆavailableˆOnceˆyourˆcheckˆdepositˆisˆaccepted,ˆhere'sˆwhenˆyouˆcanˆuseˆtheˆmoney.ˆ##ˆStandardˆavailabilityˆ-ˆTheˆfirstˆ$225ˆisˆavailableˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ-ˆTheˆrestˆisˆavailableˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆNewˆaccountsˆForˆaccountsˆopenˆlessˆthanˆ30ˆdays,ˆweˆmayˆholdˆcheckˆdepositsˆforˆupˆtoˆ7ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆLongerˆholdsˆWeˆmayˆalsoˆholdˆaˆcheckˆlongerˆifˆit'sˆunusuallyˆlargeˆforˆyourˆaccount,ˆifˆtheˆcheckˆlooksˆaltered,ˆorˆifˆitˆhasˆbeenˆreturnedˆbefore.ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆtheˆreleaseˆdateˆonˆtheˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆReturnedˆchecksˆIfˆtheˆcheckˆbouncesˆafterˆtheˆmoneyˆwasˆmadeˆavailable,ˆweˆtakeˆtheˆamountˆbackˆfromˆyourˆbalance.ˆThere'sˆnoˆreturnedˆitemˆfee.ˆDepositsˆmadeˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆbankˆholidayˆcountˆasˆreceivedˆonˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆCheckˆtheˆstatusˆTapˆtheˆdepositˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆtoˆseeˆwhetherˆit'sˆpending,ˆavailableˆorˆreturned.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
